overview.description: The Alpha Architect US Equity 4 ETF (AAUB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks long-term capital appreciation through broad exposure to the US equity market. The fund invests primarily in US companies across market sectors, styles, and market capitalizations. AAUB was launched on Jul 23, 2026 and is issued by Alpha Architect.
